verdict.rationale: Obsidian Sync is the official add-on service for privately syncing notes across devices (obsidian-docs-32). It uses end-to-end encryption by default, and the docs state that no one, not even the Obsidian team, can access your notes (obsidian-docs-21, obsidian-docs-35, obsidian-docs-9). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sync reliability and the zero-knowledge encryption claims.
